risks: Transport input has sourceMessage/externalEmail/direction/interactionAt, whereas domain contract has mailMessageRef/participant role/sourceRevision; trusted-source mapping or contract revision must be accepted before implementation.
GetCompanyInteractions is named but not specified as a typed operation; do not invent cursor/ACL/hidden-total behavior without common query contract acceptance.
Two proposed migration names appear in normative newFiles; executing both as independent schema definitions would duplicate migration authority. Selected migrator must choose actual artifact mapping.

Contact/mail-message canonical kinds are unresolved in inspected enum; person must not silently become an authentication principal or contact role synonym. Existing crm-company and binding encoding/quarantine must remain compatible.

Normalization policy, disposable/alias/internal lists and ingestion consent are underspecified; naive lowercase/local-part plus stripping or domain substring grouping can merge unrelated identities and leak scopes.

Source unique key and interaction revision policy must align with WP-18: metadata-only source revisions and duplicate webhook/refresh cannot accidentally double-count one intended interaction. Distinct new messages must still advance last interaction.
Company-level visibility must not imply source email visibility, including titles, counts, search/autocomplete previews, realtime invalidations and opaque persisted agent briefs.

Current Dossier local manual edits, notes/promises/aliases, suggestion creation, hide/delete and briefs need explicit standalone/shared writer routing; WP-23 identity migration is a later package and cannot be assumed already solved for WP-22 cutover.

Apollo retry bound/provider authorization is not specified; unavailable enrichment is an unknown-metadata state, not permission to fabricate revenue, block cursor ACK or repeatedly call provider without consent.

FeatureCompleteness requires mentions/notifications/activity/API-agent seams beyond the four explicit DAG predecessors; receipt dependencies and trigger policies must be resolved, not silently marked N/A.
